Generated metric metadata for pack scheduling, transaction, bundle, and block counters and gauges.

# Purpose
This file defines the `FD_METRICS_PACK` metric table for the pack component. It is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it only contains static metric metadata and must not be edited by hand. The table lists counters, gauges, histograms, and enum-based metrics that track pack activity such as transaction insert results, scheduling states, microblock timing, bundle status, and resource usage. The `DECLARE_METRIC*` macros expand into `fd_metrics_meta_t` entries that other code uses to register and report these metrics.
